title: Training Portal Login
scenario: A fictional student portal uses an unsafe, simulated login check. Explore how a fixed training input can change the result without touching a real website.

tasks.hint1: It is a language commonly used with databases.

tasks.prompt: What is the training input shown in the browser-mockup hint?
tasks.hint1: It is a fixed string in this safe simulator.

tasks.prompt: Use that training input in either field and sign in. What panel appears?
tasks.hint1: The mockup switches screens after its local check.

tasks.prompt: Open the simulated Inspect panel and submit its flag.
tasks.hint1: There is an Inspect panel button on the mock admin page.

learn.title: Safe input handling
learn.body: SQL means Structured Query Language. When a website mixes untrusted input into a database query, the input can change what the query means. Real applications avoid this with parameterized queries and careful validation.
